result.summary: Found 2 issues: a stuck loading indicator blocking the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image and inconsistent styling of the favorite heart button background.

issues.description: White circular loading spinner is stuck overlaying the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar cover image in the 'Popular right now' section, indicating the image did not finish loading
issues.suggestion: Ensure restaurant cover images load completely and dismiss the loading indicator; add proper loading state handling, retry logic, or a fallback image

issues.description: Favorite heart icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card lacks the dark circular background/scrim that is present behind the heart icon on the pizza card below it
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent dark scrim/circular background to all favorite buttons on restaurant cards for visibility and visual consistency
